observation.command: cd /workspace && C=$(curl -s -i --max-time 20 -X POST http://localhost:3000/api/auth/login -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"email":"tenantAdmin@buildplace.io","password":"somepassword"}' | grep -i '^set-cookie:' | sed 's/set-cookie: //I' | cut -d';' -f1); echo "cookie len: ${#C}"; echo "=== current-user ==="; curl -s --max-time 20 -H "Cookie: $C" http://localhost:3000/api/auth/current-user; echo; echo "=== me query ==="; curl -s --max-time 20 -X POST http://localhost:3000/api/graphql -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -H "Cookie: $C" -d '{"query":"query { me { id email firstName lastName } }"}'
